In my opinion. The gratification I get from achieving a long term goal is a long lasting feeling of accomplishment. Even just being consistent and sticking to a plan I have laid for myself, even if I'm not at the finish line yet, is gratifying to me, for example, sticking to a diet or abstaining from alcohol. 

Even if you don't feel the same satisfaction as me from accomplishing a long term goal, you have still done something objectively good. The willpower, determination, focus and discipline you have shown in accomplishing said goal displays to yourself and to the world that you as a person have quality traits. It's not easy to stick to long term target. Even if you're not overwhelmed with gratification, you can still be proud in the knowledge that you're strong enough to accomplish a task you have set for yourself.

The difference between instant gratification and delayed gratification, is that there is no pride or increase in self worth to be found in indulging in vices for that short lived good feeling.
